organization: WorkSafeBC / Workers’ Compensation Board of British Columbia

events.title: Workmen’s Compensation Board established
events.evidence_note: Foundation and name are documented. Do not backdate a later logo to this event.

events.title: Worker-protection emblem introduced
events.evidence_note: Official retrospective explicitly identifies a new protective-worker design. Exact artwork not recovered.

events.title: Workmen’s becomes Workers’
events.evidence_note: Name amendment documented. No separate graphic-redesign claim is made.

events.title: Provincial imagery incorporated
events.evidence_note: Year from official history; visual family association from secondary specimens. Exact lockup still needs a dated primary cross-check.

events.title: WorkSafeBC becomes the everyday name
events.evidence_note: This event dates the operating name, not necessarily the first appearance of the displayed orange wordmark.

events.title: Black-and-orange logo observed on an official service
events.evidence_note: The official live image matches the supplied visual family. Its file history and first publication date have not been established.

logo_families.label: Earlier artwork unresolved
logo_families.note: Do not assume a single logo covered 1917–1967.

logo_families.label: 1968 protective-worker design
logo_families.note: The next official redesign milestone is 1983; exact withdrawal or overlap dates are unknown.

logo_families.label: 1983 province-and-worker design family
logo_families.note: The illustrated undated lockup is associated with the family by visual correspondence, not by a dated primary specimen. Do not encode 2005 as a proven last-use date.

logo_families.label: Black-and-orange WorkSafeBC wordmark
logo_families.note: Operating-name adoption in 2005 is separately recorded; first use of this precise graphic remains unresolved.

open_questions: Pre-1968 logos or seals and their individual dates
Dated primary example of the 1983 lockup
First appearance and rollout dates of the black-and-orange graphic
Original lettering and certified colour specifications
date_rules: Year-only evidence stays year-only; no invented 1 January dates.
A publication landing-page update date is not a logo introduction date.
An observation proves use at that observation, not uninterrupted use between dates.
Institutional name changes and graphic changes are separate event types.
